<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="de">

<head>

  <meta charset="UTF-8">

  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

  <title>Deutsches Online-Reimlexikon</title>

  <style>

    :root {

      --bg-color: #0f172a;

      --card-bg: #1e293b;

      --border-color: #334155;

      --primary-color: #38bdf8;

      --primary-hover: #0284c7;

      --text-main: #f8fafc;

      --text-muted: #94a3b8;

      --accent-gold: #f59e0b;

    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    body { font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; background-color: var(--bg-color); color: var(--text-main); line-height: 1.6; padding: 20px 15px; }

    .container { max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; }

    header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 30px; padding: 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); }

    header h1 { font-size: 2.2rem; color: var(--primary-color); margin-bottom: 8px; }

    header p { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 1.05rem; }

    .search-section { background: var(--card-bg); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 12px; padding: 25px; margin-bottom: 30px; }

    .search-box { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

    .input-wrapper { flex: 1; min-width: 240px; }

    input[type="text"] { width: 100%; padding: 14px 18px; font-size: 1.1rem; border: 2px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; background: #0f172a; color: #fff; outline: none; }

    input[type="text"]:focus { border-color: var(--primary-color); }

    button.btn-search { padding: 14px 28px; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; background: var(--primary-hover); color: white; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; }

    button.btn-search:hover { background: var(--primary-color); color: #0f172a; }

    .filter-options { display: flex; gap: 20px; margin-top: 15px; padding-top: 15px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-muted); }

    .status-bar { margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--text-muted); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }

    .badge { background: #334155; color: var(--primary-color); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 20px; font-weight: bold; font-size: 0.85rem; }

    .results-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(160px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }

    .word-card { background: var(--card-bg); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 8px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 500; }

    .word-card.search-word { border-color: var(--accent-gold); color: var(--accent-gold); font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25); }

    footer { margin-top: 34px; padding-top: 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.85rem; }

    .empty-state { text-align: center; padding: 40px; background: var(--card-bg); border-radius: 12px; border: 1px dashed var(--border-color); color: var(--text-muted); }

  </style>

</head>

<body>

  <div class="container">

    <header>

<img src="https://imgur.com/oYc2rIO.jpeg" alt="Logo" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto 15px auto; max-width: 90px; height: auto;">

      <h1>Online-Reimlexikon</h1>

      <p>Finde reine und unreine Reime für Gedichte & Songtexte</p>

    </header>


    <div class="search-section">

      <div class="search-box">

        <div class="input-wrapper">

          <input type="text" id="searchInput" placeholder="Reimwort eingeben …" autocomplete="off" onkeyup="if(event.key==='Enter') searchRhymes()">

        </div>

        <button class="btn-search" onclick="searchRhymes()">Suchen</button>

      </div>

      <div class="filter-options">

        <label><input type="checkbox" id="sortAlpha" checked onchange="searchRhymes()"> Nach Wortenden sortieren</label>

        <label><input type="checkbox" id="ignoreCase" checked onchange="searchRhymes()"> Groß-/Kleinschreibung ignorieren</label>

      </div>

    </div>


    <div class="status-bar">

      <span id="statusMessage">Reimwort eingeben.</span>

      <span class="badge" id="wordCountBadge">0 Wörter geladen</span>

    </div>


    <div id="resultsContainer">

      <div class="empty-state">Gib oben ein Wort ein, um passende Reime anzuzeigen.</div>

    </div>

    <footer>Reimlexikon 2.0 – August 2026</footer>

  </div>


  <script>

UUCH;;;buch;ersuch;fluch;genug;such;überbuch;untersuch;verbuch;verfluch;versuch;;Arztbesuch;Besuch;Buch;Eunuch;Fluch;Gesuch;Hungertuch;Küchentuch;Ruch;Tagebuch;Tuch;Versuch;

UUCHTEN;;abgebuchten;abgesuchten;aufgesuchten;ausgebuchten;ausgefluchten;ausgesuchten;besuchten;betuchten;buchten;ersuchten;fluchten;gebuchten;gefluchten;gesuchten;suchten;überbuchten;umgebuchten;untersuchten;verbuchten;verfluchten;verruchten;versuchten;zurückgebuchten;zusammensuchten;

    `;


    let rhymeGroups = [];

    let uniqueWordSet = new Set();


    function normalizeWord(word, ignoreCase) {

      const cleaned = word.replace(/"/g, '').trim();

      return ignoreCase ? cleaned.toLocaleLowerCase('de') : cleaned;

    }


    function reverseWord(word) {

      return Array.from(word).reverse().join('');

    }


    function compareByEnding(a, b) {

      const reversedA = reverseWord(a.toLocaleLowerCase('de'));

      const reversedB = reverseWord(b.toLocaleLowerCase('de'));


      const endingComparison = reversedA.localeCompare(

        reversedB,

        'de',

        { sensitivity: 'base', numeric: true }

      );


      if (endingComparison !== 0) return endingComparison;

      if (a.length !== b.length) return a.length - b.length;


      return a.localeCompare(b, 'de', { sensitivity: 'base', numeric: true });

    }


    function initDatabase() {

      const lines = csvData.trim().split(/\r?\n/);

      uniqueWordSet = new Set();


      rhymeGroups = lines

        .map(line => {

          const fields = line.split(';')

            .map(field => field.replace(/"/g, '').trim())

            .filter(field => field.length > 0);


          if (fields.length < 2 || fields[0].toLocaleLowerCase('de') === 'reime') {

            return null;

          }


          const groupName = fields[0];

          const words = fields.slice(1);


          words.forEach(word => uniqueWordSet.add(word.toLocaleLowerCase('de')));

          return { name: groupName, words };

        })

        .filter(Boolean);


      document.getElementById('wordCountBadge').innerText =

        `${uniqueWordSet.size.toLocaleString('de-DE')} Wörter geladen`;

    }


    function searchRhymes() {

      const inputElement = document.getElementById('searchInput');

      const rawInput = inputElement.value.replace(/"/g, '').trim();

      const ignoreCase = document.getElementById('ignoreCase').checked;

      const sortByEnding = document.getElementById('sortAlpha').checked;

      const status = document.getElementById('statusMessage');

      const container = document.getElementById('resultsContainer');


      if (!rawInput) {

        status.innerText = 'Reimwort eingeben.';

        container.innerHTML =

          '<div class="empty-state">Gib oben ein Reimwort ein, um passende Reime anzuzeigen.</div>';

        return;

      }


      const normalizedInput = normalizeWord(rawInput, ignoreCase);

      const matches = new Map();


      // Ein Wort kann in den Rohdaten versehentlich auch als Teil einer

      // getrennten Wortfolge vorkommen, etwa "kracht;es".

      // Bei mehreren exakten Fundstellen wird deshalb die Reimgruppe gewählt,

      // deren Gruppenname am besten zum Wortende passt.

      const candidateGroups = rhymeGroups.filter(group =>

        group.words.some(word => normalizeWord(word, ignoreCase) === normalizedInput)

      );


      function commonSuffixLength(word, groupName) {

        const a = word.toLocaleLowerCase('de');

        const b = groupName.toLocaleLowerCase('de');

        let count = 0;


        while (

          count < a.length &&

          count < b.length &&

          a[a.length - 1 - count] === b[b.length - 1 - count]

        ) {

          count++;

        }

        return count;

      }


      let selectedGroups = candidateGroups;


      if (candidateGroups.length > 1) {

        const bestScore = Math.max(

          ...candidateGroups.map(group => commonSuffixLength(normalizedInput, group.name))

        );


        selectedGroups = candidateGroups.filter(

          group => commonSuffixLength(normalizedInput, group.name) === bestScore

        );

      }


      selectedGroups.forEach(group => {

        group.words.forEach(word => {

          const key = normalizeWord(word, ignoreCase);

          if (!matches.has(key)) matches.set(key, word);

        });

      });


      let results = Array.from(matches.values());


      if (results.length === 0) {

        status.innerText = `Keine Treffer für „${rawInput}“`;

        container.innerHTML =

          `<div class="empty-state">Keine Reimgruppe für <strong>„${escapeHtml(rawInput)}“</strong> gefunden.</div>`;

        return;

      }


      if (sortByEnding) {

        results.sort(compareByEnding);

      }


      status.innerText =

        `${results.length.toLocaleString('de-DE')} Wörter in der Reimgruppe für „${rawInput}“`;


      const grid = document.createElement('div');

      grid.className = 'results-grid';


      results.forEach(word => {

        const card = document.createElement('div');

        card.className = 'word-card';


        if (normalizeWord(word, ignoreCase) === normalizedInput) {

          card.classList.add('search-word');

          card.setAttribute('aria-label', `${word}, gesuchtes Wort`);

        }


        card.innerText = word;

        grid.appendChild(card);

      });


      container.innerHTML = '';

      container.appendChild(grid);

    }


    function escapeHtml(text) {

      return text

        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')

        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')

        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')

        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')

        .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');

    }


    initDatabase();

  </script>
